messages:
Marta Ruiz: quick poll 1: compact console form: do we show inline error text in dense rows or keep a small marker + top-level error summary with anchors? constraints: lots of collapsed sections, keyboard-first.
Devin Chen: inline helps mapping but causes layout shift. I'm for tiny inline markers + summary toast that lists fields with links.
Priya Singh: prefer explicit small 'Required' over just an asterisk. asterisk is compact but ambiguous for new users.
Zoe Park: a11y: if we rely on inline helpers inside collapsed panels, SRs might not announce them. we should always set aria-invalid and aria-describedby even if helper is visually hidden.
Marta Ruiz: agreed. plan: compact visual marker (dot/asterisk), aria attributes that point to a hidden SR-friendly message, and toast summary with anchor links that focus() target and open parent accordion.
Devin Chen: implementation note: on toast link click run openParentAccordion(id) then focus the field. prefer using role=alert or aria-live on the error node so SR reads it after focus rather than setTimeout hacks.
Priya Singh: typed-confirmation for destructive actions: policy suggestion: typed-confirm for irreversible (DB/audit) deletes; modal+undo for single-item UI removes. token = single lowercase word, no punctuation. add resource name + id in modal.
Zoe Park: microcopy: example: "Type delete-pool to permanently remove pool 'prod-payments' (id: 1234). This action cannot be undone." show token in monospace.
Marta Ruiz: toast collision: autosave/info toasts vs error toasts. rule: only one toast visible at a time. priority order: error > undo > info. queue lower priorities.
Devin Chen: CSS nit from QA: focus ring for compact inputs should be >=3px and meet contrast on dim theme.
design-bot: Filed: https://go.redwood/design/issues/CI-499 "Compact form validation: marker vs summary + a11y checklist". Assigned @Marta.
Marta Ruiz: action items: mock two variants (A) tiny marker + summary toast w/ anchors + ARIA, (B) persistent tiny 'Required' postfix + inline helpers. include SR announce test cases and keyboard flows. will post mocks by EOD Friday.
